integrity.infinite_proof: Point-process coupling, deterministic clique-clock identity, exact integration and Poisson process arguments are supplied in RESULT.md.

scientific_limitations: Uniform independent vertex weights; all moving thresholds are upper-endpoint perturbations of size one over sample size.
The marked graph-process total-variation bound is for fixed finite observation windows, and is not shown optimal.
Joint convergence of clique birth times is for each fixed finite collection; unbounded-index uniformity is not established.
Possible unindexed historical priority is not eliminated; no independent audit has been performed.
title: Sparse threshold-graph births and one-dependent clique clocks
